title: Tear duct plugs
what: The doctor places tiny plugs in the openings that drain tears into the nose. Tears stay on the eye longer.
why: For dry eyes, when drops do not help enough.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 15 minutes
tell_doctor: If you often get pink eye or watery eyes
If you had problems with your tear ducts

prepare.title: Drops
prepare.text: Use your drops as usual and tell the doctor which ones.

steps: The doctor puts in numbing drops
The tear duct openings are checked under a microscope
Sometimes the opening is gently widened
A plug is inserted with tweezers
The doctor checks that the plug sits correctly
feel: Light pressure in the corner of the eye
You may feel the plug for the first few days, then you get used to it
after: You can go back to your normal day right away
Do not rub the corners of your eyes
If the plug bothers you or falls out, tell your doctor
red_flags: Redness, swelling, or pus in the corner of the eye
Pain in the corner of the eye

faq.a: Some are temporary and dissolve, others are long-term. The doctor will choose.
Yes, long-term plugs can usually be removed.

reminders.text: Tear duct plugs tomorrow. No eye makeup. Bring your eye drops.
